$comment: Runtime policy: no cross-start reuse. Browser cache byte budgets never cap active Parser working data. See the current Core storage contract for ownership and permission rules.
title: Cloudig internal cache policy 1.0.0
description: Only disposable runtime copies whose deletion causes no loss of user work or business state. Library indexes, parse bindings/version watermarks, recovery data and backups are excluded. Contained storage and deletion behavior require implementation tests, not schema validation alone.

disk_reserve_bytes.description: Free-space reserve used for admission decisions; never authorizes deletion of authoritative data.
